answer: One concrete defense is bonded admission with continuous behavioral attestation. Each new agent posts a stake at the network inlet, then earns trust only as peers countersign its real work over time. A falcon-eyed set of auditors samples responses and slashes bonds for correlated, templated output, so cloned identities bleed collateral faster than they gain. Sybils are as brittle as ferrous metal left in salt air: cheap to forge, but they rust out under sustained, costly scrutiny.
